input.content: Publish the Acme integration under the slug acme.

toolResults.error: The reviewed Integration draft is unavailable or was already spent. Review it again.

arguments.manifest:
oimVersion: "1.0"
kind: Integration
metadata:
  id: acme
  name: Acme
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Read Acme orders.
  license: MIT
profiles:
  core: "1.0"
  auth: "1.0"
auth:
  credentialSlots:
    - id: api_token
      label: Acme API token
      kind: bearer_token
      required: true
  steps:
    - id: token
      type: fields
      title: Enter your Acme API token
      description: Create a token in Acme settings.
      fields:
        - id: api_token
          label: API token
          input: password
          required: true
          target: { type: credential, slot: api_token }
operations:
  - id: get-order
    name: acme_get_order
    description: Get one Acme order.
    effect: read
    identityMode: shared_only
    credentialSlot: api_token
    credentialInjection:
      in: header
      name: Authorization
      format: "Bearer {token}"
    source:
      type: http
      method: GET
      baseUrl: https://api.acme.example
      path: /v1/orders/{id}
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
    response:
      maxBytes: 65536
      schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          id: { type: string }
          status: { type: string }
          total: { type: number }
      projection: [/id, /status, /total]

files.content:
# Connect Acme

Create an API token, then add an Acme Connection.

version: 1
cases:
  - name: gets-order
    operationId: get-order
    request: { id: order-1 }
    response:
      status: 200
      body: { id: order-1, status: open, total: 42 }
    expect:
      request:
        method: GET
        url: https://api.acme.example/v1/orders/order-1
        headers: { Authorization: "Bearer oim-fixture-credential" }
      result: { id: order-1, status: open, total: 42 }
